This '''battle''' took place in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], when the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Yoshi Raph-Elan]] and the [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Lourdes]] fought against the dictator [[Gar-Oth]], who had taken control of Lourdes' home [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Gar-Oth was killed during the battle, and his [[Goliath (droid)|Goliath droid]] was destroyed, liberating the planet.
